aboutPage.heading: About Ariana Cargo
aboutPage.desc: A leading logistics company delivering reliable air, sea, and land freight solutions from Afghanistan to the world.
aboutPage.storyP1: Ariana Cargo was founded to give Afghan businesses and individuals a dependable bridge to global trade. From our head office in Kabul, we've grown a network of branch offices and international partnerships that make shipping abroad — and receiving cargo from abroad — simple, transparent, and on time.
aboutPage.storyP2: Whether it's a single package or a full container load, our team manages every step of the journey: pickup, customs clearance, transit, and final delivery — with real tracking visibility along the way.
